links.note: WAS 134 Tetravalency of Carbon. The item asks in what form carbon occurs in the ATMOSPHERE (CO and CO2 in traces) - an abundance fact. Nothing in this chapter's 20 concepts covers where carbon occurs in nature; 134 is about carbon's four valence electrons and shares only the word 'carbon'. Cleared rather than moved to an adjacent concept.
WAS 134 Tetravalency of Carbon. The item asks what fraction of the earth's crust is carbon in the form of minerals - again abundance, which no concept in the closed set covers.

WAS 134 Tetravalency of Carbon. The item asks only what a compound made of carbon is called (organic compound). The closed set has no concept defining organic compounds; 133 is catenation, 134 is the valence count, and neither is what is tested.

WAS 140 Nomenclature of Carbon Compounds, which is about naming rules. The item asks what compounds of only carbon and hydrogen are called (hydrocarbons). 135 and 136 define the saturated and unsaturated SUBTYPES, not the generic term, so nothing in the set fits.
